title: Customizations
description: V21 — "Manage, searchable" (fork of V19, from the Nov 18 standup + Nov 19 Agents Window Sync feedback). Manage opens from a title bar gear or ⌘,. One search box searches settings, customizations, models, environments, extensions and Discover, with results grouped by type. Settings is one continuous list you can filter, again. A scope switcher (All / User / Workspace / Managed) shows where each row comes from. The nav is organized by artifact (Customizations / Runtime / Workbench), with an Agent filter instead of a landing page per harness. Environments sync customizations by default, with per-environment exceptions.
